name: Berocca Performance Effervescent Tablets
ingredients: Berocca Performance tablet contains: Vitamin B1 (Thiamine hydrochloride) (as thiamine phosphate acid ester chloride dihydrate) 15 mg; Vitamin B2 (Riboflavine) (as riboflavine sodium phosphate) 15 mg; Vitamin B3 (Nicotinamide) 50 mg; Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic acid) (as calcium pantothenate) 23 mg; Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine hydrochloride) 10 mg; Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) 10 µg; Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) 500 mg; Vitamin H (Biotin) 150 µg; Folic acid 400 µg; Calcium (as calcium carbonate and calcium pantothenate) 100 mg; Magnesium (as magnesium carbonate and magnesium sulfate dihydrate) 100 mg; Zinc (as zinc citrate trihydrate) 10 mg. Also contains tabletting aids, artificial sweeteners, colour and natural flavouring.
storage: Keep the tube tightly closed in a cool dry place. Store below 25° C
note: A supplement, not a food: there is no nutrition information panel on the pack at all, hence 'nutrition' in needs. The one nutrient figure the label gives is 'Each tablet contains 274 mg sodium.' — recorded here rather than in a per-100 g table it does not have. PHENYLALANINE WARNING, quoted: 'Contains aspartame. Phenylketonurics are warned that this product contains phenylalanine.' The pack also states 'Does not contain caffeine, gluten or artificial stimulants.' — that is the only allergen-adjacent claim, so allergens.contains is empty rather than absent. Registration AUST L 193891; front is marked 'dietary supplement'. Dosage as printed: 'Adults and children over 12 years, 1 tablet, dissolved in a glass of water. Take daily or as directed by your healthcare professional.' Storage wording says 'tube' even on the 45-tablet carton — that is what the carton prints. Also listed: Bayer Australia Limited, 875 Pacific Highway, Pymble NSW 2073. Ingredient units use the micro sign (µg) as printed. No barcode in frame.
